title: Chicago's Airline Turf War Heats Up, JFK's Terminal One Slips Again, and Congress Wants to Gut National Airport
summary: American is literally handing out free elite status on planes to keep Chicago flyers loyal, while United counters with a Tokyo route relaunch — welcome to the hottest hub fight in the country. Plus, JFK's shiny new Terminal One pushes to 2027 (even as Air France unveils a massive new lounge for it), a Senate bill could gut half of Reagan National's long-haul flights, and new NTSB data reveals exactly what went wrong on that Amazon cargo jet in Miami.
